card.name: Words before a stated cause or best option
card.fires_on: Small linking words (you, is, also, the, a) that sit right before a claim about what is suspected, attributed, favored or most important. Typical setting is an explanatory sentence about a cause or a best step.

modes.label: Before suspected or attributed cause
modes.description: Small word just before a verb saying something is suspected or attributed to a cause.

modes.label: Before a favored or top item
modes.description: An article opening a phrase about the single best, most important or favorite idea.
modes.example: <<The>> single most important step you can take to

modes.label: Before a descriptive adverb or noun
modes.description: A word leading into a qualifier, such as largely, before the main term.
modes.example: every day from<< largely>> preventable causes.

card.writes: It boosts recommend-type words and suppresses alternative-type words, favoring a single preferred or stated option.
card.plain: It fires on small words just before a sentence names the main cause or the best step, not a different option.
